messages:
Lina: Heads-up to CS 1 AstraMed (fintech-health partnership) signed yesterday. ARR: $95k. They requested Dedicated+VPC and SSO (SAML). Sales noted tight timeline: pilot in 3 weeks. Renewal cycle Mar 2027 -> flag as early-touch.

Owen: Thanks @Lina 1 taking CSM. Who's the technical contact at AstraMed? Any mandatory compliance (PCI/PHI) notes?

Lina: Tech lead is Aaron Kim (aaron@astramed.co). Must adhere to PCI-lite and PHI data-in-transit/auditability. Sales included clause: no model training on customer data; logging retention 90 days.

Sam: Support Eng here. I'll own the eng escalation path + initial alerting. Need SAML metadata and a preferred CIDR. Also: do we require HSM for KMS?

Lina: Aaron said customer-managed KMS preferred but can accept Redwood KMS for pilot. SAML metadata pending from their SSO team; expect it tomorrow.

Priya: Action list proposal:
- Priya: kickoff + product walkthrough with Aaron + infra (by Tue) :calendar: 
- Sam: create ENG ticket ASTRA-ENG-1 with runbook template and responder list (today) :gear: 
- Owen: request SAML metadata + CIDR + KMS decision from Aaron (today) :email: 
- DevOps-bot: provision staging ded cluster once CIDR provided.

Sam: Creating ASTRA-ENG-1 now. Pre-seeding runbook with escalation to oncall and exec contact. Runbook questions:
```
- Expected qps and p95 target
- Peak seq len for chat/embedding
- Data retention window
- PCI/PHI zones (yes/no)
```

Owen: Pilot acceptance metrics from sales: p95 < 60ms for 256-token generate, embeddings throughput 300/min, error rate < 0.5%. Pilot length 14 days. Billing cap set. If usage > 80% of cap, trigger billing/commit discussion.

Lina: Noted. Renewal risk: medium-high until PCI/PHI checklist is signed and SAML + KMS confirmed. Logging & auditability are negotiation points.

Sam: Quick infra note: for initial Dedicated test we'll use a 2xA10 pool with int8 quant. Plan: prefix cache ON to mimic prod. If they require strict data segregation, we'll disable shared cache.

Priya: Also want to capture feedback during pilot: short NPS-style + 2 technical questions after milestone 1 and 2. I'll draft a 4-question survey and attach to ASTRA-ENG-1.

DevOps-bot: Ticket ASTRA-ENG-1 created and assigned to Sam. Provisioning hold until CIDR and SAML metadata received.

Sam: Draft runbook posted to ASTRA-ENG-1 (link). Key thresholds: error rate > 0.5% over 5m, p95 > 120ms -> auto page. Escalation order: oncall -> Sam -> Owen -> Priya.

Owen: I emailed Aaron for CIDR and SAML. He replied: CIDR 10.40.0.0/16; SAML metadata attached. KMS: will start with Redwood KMS for pilot, evaluate CMK later.

Priya: Great. I'll schedule kickoff for 2025-08-05 09:00 PT and invite Aaron, his infra lead, Sam, and Lina. Also tracking renewal engagement in SFDC with early-warning tag.

Lina: Sales will follow up on legal items (logging retention clause). They expect to accept our 90-day retention for pilot.

Sam: With CIDR + SAML in hand I'll request provisioning. If they ask for HSM later, create a new procurement ticket.

Priya: Final owners recap:
- CSM: Owen (kickoff, enablement, renewal tracking)
- Eng owner: Sam (runbook, alerts, ASTRA-ENG-1)
- Sales legal: Lina (logging/retention, contract items)
- Infra: DevOps-bot (provisioning hold/unhold)

Lina: Anything else? If not, I'll hand off and step out.

Owen: All good. I'll update CS workspace and close the handoff note after kickoff. :rocket:
